visualCharacteristics.purpose: Text beside an image or a dark info box
visualCharacteristics.description: Two fixed cells side by side from 768px (stacked on mobile). Cell 1 is text (optional uppercase eyebrow paragraph or H2, paragraphs). Cell 2 is either an image or a dark navy text box (H2 + lists shown side by side); either way it has a cut-off top-right corner (21px mobile, 41px from 768px). Option dark: the first text cell is the navy box (white text, optional white outline button) butted against the image with no gap; image above the box on mobile, side by side from 768px, box capped at 634px from 1024px. A second text cell that ends with an image renders as the navy notched box with that image directly underneath (stacked until 1024px, halves with a 26px gap from 1024px). A list whose items all start with an icon renders as a ruled icon list.
visualCharacteristics.source: Industry pages: .industries-view-top (text | image) and .industries-view-range-tool (text | dark .clip-box with two lists). Careers: .career-kgs-diamond (dark). About us: .about-purpose (dark), .about-our-mission (text + icon list | navy box with trailing image).

contentPattern.structure: 1 row x 2 cells: text | image, or text | text (H2 + lists)
rows: Text: eyebrow paragraph or H2, paragraphs
Image (optional second image = mobile crop) OR H2 + one or more lists
Text (H2/H3, paragraphs, optional icon list, optional link)
Image OR text box (H2/H3, paragraphs, optional trailing image)

reuseGuidance: Use for a fixed text + notched image pair, or text + dark notched box with lists. A second cell without an image becomes the dark box automatically; two images in the image cell are desktop then mobile. Add the dark option when the text cell itself is the navy panel beside a photo. End the second (box) cell with an image to place a photo under the navy box.
